targets.query: from(bucket:"hive") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weight" and r.hive_id == "${hive}" and r._field == "kg")
from(bucket:"hive") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "brood" and r.hive_id == "${hive}" and r._field =~ /^probes_/)
from(bucket:"hive") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "env" and r.hive_id == "${hive}")
from(bucket:"hive") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sound" and r.hive_id == "${hive}" and r._field =~ /^bands_db_/)
from(bucket:"hive") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node" and r.hive_id == "${hive}" and (r._field == "rssi" or r._field == "vbat" or r._field == "uptime_s")) |> last()
